q: 我下班以后常常去公司楼下___篮球。
en: After work I often play basketball downstairs from the office.

q: 邻居家的孩子每天晚上都在练___钢琴。
en: The neighbours' child practises the piano every evening.

s: 周末我们去公园踢篮球。

q: 楼上的邻居会___小提琴，我们晚上常常能听到。
en: The neighbour upstairs plays the violin, and we often hear it in the evening.

q: 吃完晚饭，爷爷和邻居在楼下___棋。
en: After dinner Grandpa plays chess with a neighbour downstairs.

s: 太晚了，我们打车回家吧。

q: 我的手机没电了，能借你的手机给家里___个电话吗？
en: My phone is out of battery. Could I borrow yours to call home?

q: 孩子发烧了，医生让他去医院___针。
en: The child has a fever, and the doctor told him to go to the hospital for an injection.

s: 妈妈给孩子穿了一顶红帽子。

q: 公园里有几个小孩在___足球。
en: A few children are playing football in the park.

q: 天气冷了，出门要___厚外套。
en: It is getting cold; wear a thick coat when you go out.

q: 他的眼睛不好，平时都___着一副眼镜。
en: His eyesight is poor, so he usually wears glasses.

s: 他穿着一双旧皮鞋，戴着一块旧手表。

q: 医生进手术室以前，要先___上口罩。
en: Before going into the operating room the doctor first puts on a mask.

q: 面试的时候，他___了一条蓝色的领带。
en: At the interview he wore a blue tie.

s: 下班以后，我骑公共汽车回家。

q: 你的鞋带松了，快蹲下来___好。
en: Your shoelace is loose; crouch down and tie it quickly.

q: 商店里的裙子很漂亮，我想___上试试。
en: The skirts in the shop are lovely; I want to try one on.

s: 我哥哥每天开自行车去公司。

q: 他手腕上___着一块很贵的手表。
en: He is wearing a very expensive watch on his wrist.

q: 我的运动鞋湿了，今天只能___皮鞋去上班。
en: My trainers are wet, so today I can only wear leather shoes to work.

q: 我家离公司很远，我每天___地铁上班。
en: My home is far from the office, so I take the subway to work every day.

s: 下午的会已经开了两个小时了。

q: 我家离超市很近，我常常___自行车去买菜。
en: My home is close to the supermarket, so I often cycle there to buy food.

q: 我爸爸在一家公司当司机，每天都___公司的车接送经理。
en: My dad is a driver at a company and drives the company car to pick up and drop off the manager every day.

s: 晚上我喜欢在家读电视。

q: 房间里太黑了，你能帮我把灯___一下吗？
en: It is too dark in the room; could you turn on the light for me?

q: 别当真，我只是跟你___玩笑。
en: Don't take it seriously; I was only joking with you.

s: 他感冒了，所以今天在家喝汤吃药。

q: 我们明天上午要___飞机去上海出差。
en: Tomorrow morning we are flying to Shanghai on a business trip.

q: 办公室太热了，我们___空调吧。
en: The office is too hot; let us switch on the air conditioning.

q: 我头疼得很厉害，下午想去医院___病。
en: My head hurts badly; this afternoon I want to go to the hospital to see a doctor.

s: 饭馆里不能喝烟，请到外面去。

q: 这种药饭后___，一次两片。
en: Take this medicine after meals, two tablets at a time.

q: 医生说他身体不好，不能再___烟了。
en: The doctor says his health is poor and he must not smoke any more.

s: 妈妈在厨房里办晚饭。

q: 我爸爸晚饭后喜欢坐在沙发上___电视。
en: After dinner my dad likes sitting on the sofa watching TV.

q: 老师让我们大声___课文。
en: The teacher asks us to read the text aloud.

s: 他毕业以后在网上做生意，做得不错。

q: 我姐姐在北京___大学，学的是中文。
en: My older sister is at university in Beijing, studying Chinese.

q: 你感冒了，多___点儿热水。
en: You have a cold; drink more hot water.

q: 我今天加班，回家太晚了，没有时间___饭。
en: I worked overtime today and got home too late to cook.

s: 我弟弟还没办作业，不能出去玩。

q: 新同事今天来公司报到，要先___入职手续。
en: The new colleague is reporting to the company today and must first complete the joining formalities.

q: 我昨天太累了，晚上___了一个很长的梦。
en: I was very tired yesterday and had a very long dream at night.

s: 外面在雨，我们别出去了。

q: 这家饭馆的厨师很会___菜，客人特别多。
en: The chef at this restaurant cooks very well, so there are lots of customers.

q: 他想在城里开一家饭馆，自己___生意。
en: He wants to open a restaurant in the city and run his own business.

s: 我们公司五点半下班，我六点半才能到家。

q: 这个问题很复杂，我还没___清楚。
en: This problem is complicated and I haven't figured it out yet.

q: 孩子每天放学回家，先___作业，然后才能玩。
en: Every day when the child comes home from school he does his homework first and only then can he play.

q: 我们公司早上九点___班，下午六点下班。
en: Our company starts work at nine in the morning and finishes at six in the afternoon.

s: 我每天早上七点去班，晚上六点回家。

q: 铃声一响就___课了，同学们都跑去食堂吃饭。
en: As soon as the bell rang, class was over and the students all ran off to the canteen to eat.

q: 外面___着很大的雨，你带伞了吗？
en: It is raining hard outside; did you bring an umbrella?

s: 他在上课，等一下再给他打电话吧。

q: 北京的冬天常常___雪，很冷。
en: It often snows in Beijing in winter, and it is very cold.

q: 我___决心，从明天起每天早上去跑步。
en: I've made up my mind to go running every morning from tomorrow.

s: 我给你寄了一条短信，你收到了吗？

q: 办公室的电脑不能___网，我没法发邮件。
en: The computer in the office cannot get online, so I can't send email.

q: 我妹妹今年十八岁，明年就要___大学了。
en: My younger sister is eighteen and will start university next year.

q: 我昨天给经理___了一封邮件，他还没有回。
en: I sent the manager an email yesterday and he hasn't replied yet.

s: 我想去邮局给老家的朋友寄一封信。

q: 这个月的工资公司已经___了，你看看银行卡。
en: The company has already paid this month's salary; check your bank card.

q: 我想去邮局给老家的奶奶___一个包裹。
en: I want to go to the post office and send a parcel to my grandma back home.

s: 老师提了一个问题，同学们都回答不出来。

q: 开会的时候，大家都对新办法___了很多意见。
en: At the meeting everyone made lots of comments on the new method.

q: 老师问了我一个问题，我马上___了。
en: The teacher asked me a question and I answered it right away.

s: 我每天早上起床以后先洗牙，再吃早饭。

q: 电脑坏了，这个问题只有修理师傅才能___。
en: The computer is broken, and only the repairman can solve this problem.

q: 孩子昨天晚上___烧了，今天要去医院看看。
en: The child had a fever last night and today we are going to the hospital.

q: 我们在公园玩吧，我在花旁边给你___张照片。
en: Let's play in the park, and I'll take a photo of you next to the flowers.

s: 今年春节，我们一家人去南方度假。

q: 李老师的朋友是演员，现在在上海___电影。
en: Teacher Li's friend is an actor and is now filming a movie in Shanghai.

q: 我每天早上起床后先___牙，再洗脸。
en: Every morning after getting up I brush my teeth first and then wash my face.

s: 明天晚上我们去饭馆开生日吧。

q: 她每天出门以前都要___头，把头发弄整齐。
en: She combs her hair every day before leaving home so that it looks neat.

q: 今天是妈妈的生日，我们去饭馆给她___生日吧。
en: It is Mum's birthday today; let's go to a restaurant to celebrate it with her.

s: 我每天早上七点取床。

q: ___马路的时候，要看红绿灯。
en: When you cross the road you must watch the traffic lights.

q: 天气太热了，我一回家就想先___个澡。
en: It is so hot that as soon as I get home I want to take a shower first.

q: 明天早上有会，我得六点___床。
en: I have a meeting tomorrow morning, so I have to get up at six.

s: 我去银行取了一千块钱。

q: 我没带现金，得先去银行___钱。
en: I have no cash on me, so I have to go to the bank and take out some money first.

q: 他每天都玩游戏，不做作业，妈妈很___气。
en: He plays games every day and does not do his homework, so his mum is very angry.

s: 她生了孩子以后，就没有再上班了。

q: 他昨天淋了雨，晚上就___病了，今天没来上班。
en: He got caught in the rain yesterday, fell ill at night and did not come to work today.

q: 老师今天给我们___了很多作业，周末都没时间玩了。
en: The teacher set us a lot of homework today, so there is no time to play at the weekend.

s: 这杯茶太强了，我喝不下去。

q: 我打算明年去英国___学，学习英语。
en: I plan to go to Britain next year to study abroad and learn English.

q: 晚上喝太___的茶会睡不着觉。
en: If you drink very strong tea in the evening you won't be able to sleep.

q: 这家饭馆的咖啡太___了，像水一样，没有味道。
en: The coffee at this restaurant is too weak; it is like water and has no flavour.

s: 这场雨下得很大，路上的车都开得很慢。

q: 外面雨下得很___，我们等雨小一点儿再走吧。
en: It is raining hard outside; let us wait until the rain eases before leaving.

q: 他的病很___，医生说要住院一个月。
en: His illness is serious; the doctor says he needs to stay in hospital for a month.

s: 昨天下了一场重雨，路上到处都是水。

q: 这件衬衫的颜色太___了，我想换一件深一点儿的。
en: The colour of this shirt is too light; I want to swap it for a darker one.

q: 这家饭馆的服务给我留下了很___的印象。
en: The service at this restaurant left a deep impression on me.

s: 我不喜欢太淡的茶，喜欢浓一点儿的。

q: 房间里太吵了，请把电视的声音开___一点儿。
en: It is too noisy in the room; please turn the TV down a bit.
